clips.title: The story
paras: At the Moonkin Stone, you face a trial of body and heart to master Bear Form. Turak Runetotem sends young tauren druids from Thunder Bluff to summon and defeat Lunaclaw near the border of Mulgore and the Barrens.

Turak Runetotem tests young tauren druids who seek the path of the Druid of the Claw. After you commune with the Great Bear Spirit in Moonglade, your training turns to a trial of strength. Turak, the elder druid trainer atop the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, gives worthy aspirants Cenarion Lunardust. He sends you to a sacred stone near the dry frontier where Mulgore meets the Barrens.

West of Camp Taurajo, the Moonkin Stone marks a rare Cenarion site in southern Kalimdor. Moonkin are not native to the sun-scorched plains of central Kalimdor, and Lunaclaw guards the stone. Scatter the lunardust across the ancient monument to call Lunaclaw into battle. Defeating the guardian proves your strength and clarity of heart, earning its blessing and awakening the bear's inner essence.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: On land west of Taurajo in the Barrens - just before it turns into Mulgore - lies a Moonkin Stone. The moonkin are special beasts, not native to these parts. Lunaclaw, the stone's defender, will face you when Cenarion Lunardust is applied to it. Lunaclaw possesses within it a strength that you must use as one of the Claw.
You've earned the right to use this Cenarion Lunardust, friend... Now show me that you've earned the right to possess the strength of body and the strength of heart needed as a druid!

clips.title: Progress
paras: When you have faced the challenge that lies before you, your understanding of strength of body and strength of heart will be fully realized. Until that time, I cannot help you further.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have finally taken your large step into a much larger world, friend. I sense the teaching of the Great Bear Spirit within you, and I sense that you have received the strength that Lunaclaw possessed.
There are no further obstacles in your way... Let me now teach you what it means to be a Druid of the Claw!
